output.summary: The group-wide 17-18 minute ticket time is a deliberate, board-accepted result of the 2024 Made Here redesign. It was projected in advance, and all nine locations rose together in October 2024. It sits under the 19-minute ceiling. Satisfaction and food quality rose, and speed scores are unchanged, so the 12-minute benchmark and the group-wide inefficiency claim are not supported. Riverside's deterioration began in August 2026 with the saute/pasta cook's departure and an unfilled vacancy. KDS timings localize the delay to that station, and group operations deferred the GM's transfer requests. Restore the position and monitor Riverside. Do not switch to frozen components, set a 12-minute bonus target, or fire the GM. Delgado's reasons remain unknown.
